steps.title: Front stub
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as crankshaft_3.ipt.
Sketch a 2.50 in (63.5) circle on the YZ Plane. Extrude 3.55 in (90.17).
steps.note: The drawing is in inches; the model is in millimetres (x 25.4).

steps.title: Webs
actions: Sketch a web: a circle R2.00 in (50.8) on the main axis and a circle R1.75 in (44.45) on the pin centre, 2.50 in (63.5) below, joined by two tangent lines. Extrude 0.75 in (19). Fillet the edges R0.10 in (2.54). Make six webs, a pair to each throw, the throws turned 120 degrees apart.
steps.note: The drawing crowns the web faces with an R169 radius; the model keeps them flat.

steps.title: Crank pins
actions: Sketch a 3.00 in (76.2) circle on each pin centre. Extrude 2.15 in (54.62) between the webs.
steps.note: Three throws at 120 degrees: one cylinder fires every 240 degrees of a four stroke cycle.

steps.title: Main journals
actions: Sketch a 2.50 in (63.5) circle on the main axis between the throws. Extrude 2.10 in (53.34).

steps.title: Rear stub
actions: Sketch a 2.50 in circle on the last web. Extrude 3.55 in (90.17). 22.24 in (564.88) overall.

steps.title: End chamfers
actions: Chamfer the two shaft ends 1.5 mm.
